definitions.amb_mean: Mean ambient light reading across the window.
definitions.amb_max: Maximum ambient light reading across the window.
definitions.amb_std: Population standard deviation of ambient light readings across the window.
definitions.prox_mean: Mean proximity reading across the window.
definitions.prox_max: Maximum proximity reading across the window.
definitions.prox_min: Minimum proximity reading across the window.
definitions.prox_std: Population standard deviation of proximity readings across the window.
definitions.temp_mean: Mean temperature in degrees Celsius across the window.
definitions.rh_mean: Mean relative humidity percentage across the window.
definitions.temp_delta: Last minus first temperature in degrees Celsius within the window.
definitions.rh_delta: Last minus first relative humidity percentage within the window.
